basis: NIST SP 800-63B-4 (2025) for length, blocklist, and strength; common sites and PCI DSS v4.0.1 for the four character types
lengthUnit: Unicode code points after NFC normalization

estimator.name: zxcvbn
estimator.python: zxcvbn 4.5.0, called with max_length equal to maxLength

checks.rule: Fails when the normalized password has fewer than minLength characters.
Fails when the normalized password has more than maxLength characters.
Fails when the password has no capital letter from A to Z.
Fails when the password has no small letter from a to z.
Fails when the password has no number from 0 to 9.
Fails when the password has none of the characters in symbols. A space and other characters are allowed, but they do not count as a symbol.
Lowercase the password. Fails when it contains the username or the email name (the part before the last @). Each one counts only when it has at least minPersonalLength characters after trimming.
Ask the estimator for all its matches (omnimatch). Fails when one match is from its "passwords" list and covers the whole password, including other capital letters, l33t, and reversed forms.
Run the estimator with the username and email name as user inputs. Map its score to the highest level whose minScore it reaches. Fails when that level is below requiredLevel.
checks.message: Too easy to guess. Avoid patterns.

result: Run the checks in order and stop at the first failure. A failed check gives the level "weak" and its id as the reason. If all checks pass, the password is accepted with the estimated level and no reason.
